data.gender_notes: Intezamia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is attentive and watchful, especially towards her faith and responsibilities. The name Intezamia carries the meaning “Attentiveness, Watchfulness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Intezamia usually hope their child will grow to embody attentiveness, watchfulness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Intezamia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Intezamia
in_english.long_meaning: Intezamia: Diligent, organized, systematic, well-ordered, well-planned. This name is derived from the Arabic root N-T-Z-M. It represents the person who is diligent in their work, organized in their life, systematic in their approach, well-ordered in their thoughts, and well-planned in their actions. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the concept of diligence, organization, and systematic approach to life. It is a name that reflects the person's ability to manage their time effectively, prioritize their tasks, and achieve their goals in a well-planned manner.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Intezamia serves as a reminder of the constant vigilance needed to remain steadfast in one's faith and connection with Allah. It is a call to remain watchful over one's thoughts, words, and actions, ensuring that they align with the teachings and values of Islam. Ultimately, Intezamia embodies the ideals of being a conscious, mindful, and devout servant of Allah.
